steps.en: Install IdeaVim from the IDE's plugin manager
steps.zh: 在 IDE 的插件管理里安装 IdeaVim

steps.en: Its Vim engine takes over keystroke handling in the editor pane
steps.zh: Vim 引擎接管编辑器面板的按键处理

steps.en: Put your Vim-flavoured settings in the ideavimrc file
steps.zh: 把 Vim 风格设置写进 ideavimrc 文件

steps.en: Bind IDE actions to Vim keys with an Action mapping
steps.zh: 用 Action 映射把 IDE 动作绑到 Vim 键上

steps.en: Modes, operators and macros apply to the IDE's own document — refactorings and debugger unchanged
steps.zh: 模式与宏作用在 IDE 自己的文档上，重构与调试器照常

value.en: Vim muscle memory and JetBrains' semantic tooling in one editor, toggled off any time
value.zh: 一个编辑器里同时拥有 Vim 肌肉记忆和 JetBrains 语义工具，随时一键切回

sources: README.md master @ 2026-09-28 — Setup: 'IdeaVim can be installed via Settings | Plugins'; 'Use Tools | Vim in the menu to enable or disable vim'; 'Use the ~/.ideavimrc file as an analog of ~/.vimrc'; example ideavimrc block: 'set surround', 'map <leader>r <Action>(RenameElement)'; 'source ~/.vimrc'
